title: Wire vibecodeleaderboard-frontend into declarative-config's Argo Workflows website-build pipeline (ADR-001)
description: Implements docs/plan/plan.md ADR-001 from the jedarden/vibecodeleaderboard-frontend repo. Work happens in jedarden/declarative-config (separate repo/worktree): add a new dependency+trigger to k8s/iad-ci/argo-events/website-build-sensor.yml for vibecodeleaderboard-frontend using the website-build WorkflowTemplate (k8s/iad-ci/argo-workflows/website-build-workflowtemplate.yml) with build-command: "true" and output-dir: "." (this repo is plain static HTML/CSS/JS with no build step - mirror the artifacts-hardyrekshin-com-deploy trigger, the closest existing analog). Also create the 'vibecodeleaderboard-frontend' Cloudflare Pages project (parallel to the other cf-project values already wired on this template) and confirm a GitHub webhook exists on jedarden/vibecodeleaderboard-frontend pointing at the iad-ci github-webhooks EventSource. Commit+push declarative-config per its own git discipline (git pull --rebase, push immediately). Do not carry over the old workflow's 'fetch leaderboard.json from API during deploy' step - see the separate placeholder-data bead in this repo.

title: Virtualize the leaderboard table instead of full-array re-render on Load More
description: js/app.js renderLeaderboard() rebuilds the full visible slice (tbody.innerHTML = pageData.map(...).join('')) on every 'Load More' click, and loadLeaderboard() fetches the entire leaderboard.json unconditionally on page load with no pagination. The site's own meta description claims '152K+ users, 7M+ commits' scale - at that size this means a multi-MB JSON fetch plus an ever-growing full DOM rebuild instead of incremental append. Add row virtualization/windowing (e.g. render only rows near the viewport, append-only instead of full innerHTML replace on Load More) so DOM node count stays bounded regardless of total leaderboard size. File: js/app.js (renderLeaderboard, loadMore).

title: Gate Generate-Report / live-API profile fallback behind a reachability check
description: js/report.js ReportGenerator.generate() and js/profile.js loadFromAPI() both assume https://api.<hostname> is reachable. Verified 2026-07-20: the domain has no DNS record and the paired backend (claude-leaderboard Deployment on apexalgo-iad) is scaled to 0/0 replicas (see docs/plan/plan.md). Today, clicking 'Generate Report' opens a modal that hangs on a dead EventSource with no timeout, and profile.js silently mislabels API-unreachable as 'user not found'. Add a short-timeout reachability check (e.g. fetch with AbortController, ~2s timeout, to ${API_BASE}/health) before opening the report modal in js/report.js and before the API fallback in js/profile.js loadUserData(); on failure show an explicit 'report generation is temporarily unavailable' message instead of hanging or mislabeling. Files: js/report.js, js/profile.js, js/app.js (showGenerateReportOption).

title: Render per-user Open Graph tags server-side so social unfurls actually work
description: js/profile.js updateMetaTags() mutates <meta property=og:*> tags client-side after DOMContentLoaded, but link-unfurl crawlers (Slack, X/Twitter, Discord, iMessage) fetch raw HTML and do not execute JavaScript - every /u/<username> share currently unfurls as the generic 'Vibe Code Leaderboard' card, never the per-user rank/stats this feature (commit 8faf52d, bf-4g1a) was built to show. generateOGImageUrl() in js/profile.js also always returns the static default og-image.png regardless of user - there is no dynamic per-user OG image generation at all. Fix: add a Cloudflare Pages Function (e.g. functions/u/[username].js) that reads leaderboard.json (and/or the API once live) server-side and injects real og:title/og:description/og:image into the HTML response before it reaches crawlers, keeping the existing client-side js/profile.js for the interactive page. Files: user.html, js/profile.js, new functions/ directory. References docs/plan/plan.md ADR-001 (same Cloudflare Pages deployment this depends on).

title: Replace deprecated document.execCommand('copy') with Clipboard API
description: js/profile.js window.copyShareUrl() uses the deprecated document.execCommand('copy') (deprecated per MDN, unreliable in some browsers/contexts). Replace with navigator.clipboard.writeText(url) as the primary path, keeping execCommand only as a fallback for contexts without the Clipboard API (e.g. non-HTTPS local dev via python -m http.server). File: js/profile.js (copyShareUrl).

title: Add debounced substring search instead of exact-username-match-only
description: js/app.js handleSearch() only matches u.username.toLowerCase() === query.toLowerCase() against the baked-in leaderboard - no partial/substring matching, and it only fires on button click or Enter (no live/debounced search-as-you-type). Add debounced (~200ms) input-driven substring search with a small results list, falling back to the existing exact-match 'Generate Report' prompt only when zero substring matches are found. Files: js/app.js (setupEventListeners, handleSearch), index.html (search input).

title: Delete GitHub Actions deploy workflow and disable Actions on GitHub mirrors (ADR-001)
description: Implements docs/plan/plan.md ADR-001. Delete .github/workflows/deploy.yml (it has failed on both of its runs ever - missing CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN/CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID secrets, and its optional leaderboard.json refresh step fails because api.vibecodeleaderboard.com has no DNS record). Also disable GitHub Actions at the repo-settings level on both github.com/jedarden/vibecodeleaderboard-frontend and github.com/ardenone/vibecodeleaderboard-frontend - deleting the workflow file alone does not stop a repo with Actions enabled from re-triggering on a future push (known fleet gotcha). Verify with 'gh run list -R jedarden/vibecodeleaderboard-frontend' showing no new runs after the next push. This repo's origin is Forgejo (git.ardenone.com/jedarden/vibecodeleaderboard-frontend), which push-mirrors to both GitHub orgs.

title: Add explicit width/height to avatar tags to prevent layout shift
description: Avatar tags in js/app.js (renderUserRow, showUserResult) and js/profile.js (renderProfile) don't set explicit width/height or use aspect-ratio CSS, causing layout shift (CLS) as each avatar image loads - most visible on the leaderboard table where dozens of avatars load at once via loading=lazy. Add explicit width/height attributes matching the CSS-rendered avatar size (see .user-avatar / .profile-avatar rules in css/style.css and css/profile.css) so layout is stable before images decode. Files: js/app.js, js/profile.js, css/style.css, css/profile.css.

title: Replace synthetic testuserNNN placeholder data in leaderboard.json or label it as demo data
description: leaderboard.json as committed ships testuser088/089/090/... entries with an identical stat block each (497 commits, 174 commits_30d, 5 repos, same recent_repos pattern) - synthetic fixture data, not real leaderboard content. Per docs/plan/plan.md, the real backend is scaled to 0/0 and its replacement (devimprint pipeline) isn't wired up yet. Until real data exists: add a visible 'demo data' banner in index.html whenever the data source is the baked-in JSON, so a real visitor isn't misled into thinking these are real GitHub users/stats. Must be resolved (or the banner added) before the site, once deployed per ADR-001, is promoted or linked publicly. Files: leaderboard.json, index.html, js/app.js (updateStats/loadLeaderboard).

title: Add the missing og-image.png social-share asset referenced by index.html and user.html

comments.author: cli
comments.text:
Concrete gap found in plan-vs-artifacts audit (2026-07-29). Both index.html (line 11) and user.html (lines 11 and 16) reference https://vibecodeleaderboard.com/og-image.png in their og:image / twitter:image meta tags, but no image file exists anywhere in the repo (git ls-files shows zero .png/.ico/.svg/.jpg/.webp assets). Every social-share unfurl therefore points at a 404, so even the default share card renders blank.

This is NOT covered by bf-46h: that bead is scoped to dynamic per-user OG injection via a Cloudflare Pages Function under functions/u/<username>, and it assumes the static default og-image.png already exists (it notes generateOGImageUrl() always returns the static default og-image.png). The main leaderboard page (index.html) is entirely outside bf-46h's /u/<username> scope and will still reference a nonexistent image after bf-46h ships.

Acceptance criteria:
- A branded og-image.png (recommended 1200x630) exists at the repo root so it resolves at /og-image.png once deployed per ADR-001.
- index.html and user.html og:image / twitter:image meta tags resolve to a real 200 asset (verify after deploy or against a local static server).
- The default social card renders correctly for the main leaderboard page and for any /u/<username> profile before bf-46h per-user image work lands.
- Optional adjacent nicety: neither index.html nor user.html references a favicon (no rel=icon link at all); consider adding one in the same pass, but the load-bearing gap is the missing og-image.png.

Files: index.html, user.html, new og-image.png at repo root.
